card.name: Words right before the word people
card.fires_on: Words that sit just before an expected "people" or similar group noun, such as "white", "majority of", "more and more" or "400 million". It appears in general web prose about groups of people.

modes.label: Modifier before people
modes.description: An adjective or number that is followed by the noun "people".
modes.example: The nonwhite/victim of racism person will seek space for<< white>> people in discussion of racism.

modes.label: Quantity linker
modes.description: A linking word such as "of" after a quantity, where a group noun comes next.
modes.example: In the range of 25 percent to 60 percent the majority<< of>> people cannot sense any difference.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of "people" and similar words next, and slightly raises singular person words like "一名".
card.plain: It fires on the word just ahead of "people", when the text is about to name a group of people.
